# believes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/believes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent holds a proposition to be true — the base doxastic attitude. Range is intentionally OPEN: the object may be a [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md), a reified statement, or any claim the agent holds (the five-minute-gate shortcut, [Principle 13](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-13)); the typed content link arrives at the reified doxastic state in a sibling child. Non-functional — an agent holds many beliefs, and contested beliefs coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). How strongly, and from whose vantage, rides [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) and [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement, never a truth bit here.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an agent holds a proposition (or any reified statement / claim) to be true — the base doxastic attitude and the cheap 80% surface; how strongly and from whose vantage ride [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) and [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the holding statement.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as a global truth claim — believing is one agent's held attitude, never a factive knowledge verdict; for a merely entertained premise use [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) (no belief), for the justified case use [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md), and never force one belief to win in a merge (it is non-functional).

### How to use

- Point the agent at a [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md) or reified statement; carry strength and frame on [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) / [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) of the statement, and promote to the reified doxastic state (sibling child) only when credence, justification, or the mental moment must be first-class.

### Scope notes

- believes is documented — not axiomatised — as riding [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement (an [owl:ObjectProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty) cannot [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) an [owl:AnnotationProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#AnnotationProperty) in OWL 2 DL; the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) / [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) precedent). Realised in the projection layer.

### Examples

- ex:alice [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) ex:earthIsRound.
